falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the 'bottom_2024_aug' pattern match, as that pattern resolved with lower lows; this would signal the correction ended prematurely and the macro engine's bearish read was wrong

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained complacency at pre-correction volatility levels would falsify the bottoming narrative, as genuine macro bottoms exhibit elevated volatility for weeks; this would indicate a risk-on regime the model failed to capture

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield breaks above 4.50% and holds there for 2 consecutive closes
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A renewed violent rates selloff with no equity drawdown would invalidate the pattern match—bottom_2024_aug featured rates rallying (yields falling) as equities stabilized; divergent rates/equity behavior proves the analog is broken

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
